parameters.query: SELECT t.table_name, COALESCE(s.n_tup_ins + s.n_tup_upd + s.n_tup_del, 0)::text as mod_count FROM information_schema.tables t LEFT JOIN pg_stat_user_tables s ON s.relname = t.table_name WHERE t.table_schema = 'public' AND t.table_type = 'BASE TABLE' ORDER BY t.table_name
